body.p: Claims 1-20 are currently pending in the present application.

In the Office Action, the Examiner rejected claims 1-20 on the ground on nonstatutory double patenting and being unpatentable over claims 1-20 of US Patent No. 11,909,576. While Applicant disagrees with the Examiner's analysis with respect to this rejection, a terminal disclaimer is being filed contemporaneously with this paper, rendering the rejection moot.

Applicants believe that the claims are in condition for allowance. A Notice of Allowance for all claims is respectfully requested. If the Examiner has any questions or comments, the Examiner is requested to contact the undersigned at 515-242-8965.
Respectfully submitted, Fredrikson and Byron, P.A.
